model_flags.translation: Listen son, you have to talk tomorrow, come here. If you need a service tomorrow, tell me, I will do half an hour for three hundred rupees.
model_flags.excerpt: सुन लो बेटा कल को बात करना है क्या उससे यहीं पे आ जाओ बेटा कल सर्विस चाहिए तो बताओ आधे घंटे करूँगी तीन सौ रुपये
model_flags.model_context: The user is proposing a service for the next day and stating the price for a half-hour session. The expert responded with an affirmative.
